entities.summary: Arlen Dale "Bucky" Bockhorn is an American former basketball player. He was a guard for the National Basketball Association's Cincinnati Royals from 1958 to 1965. He played college basketball for the Dayton Flyers and is a member of Dayton's Hall of Fame and All-Century team.
